findings.description: WhatNow's account of the same Bonacker opening already on this page from the San Francisco Chronicle, two days earlier.

citation.label: WhatNow San Francisco, “The Bonacker To Open In San Francisco,” 25 September 2026

raw.text: planned for 568 Sacramento Street ... in the former Leo's Oyster Bar space ... expected to open in early 2027

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 568 SACRAMENTO ST → parcel 0228011; sf-parcels has blklot 0228011 active, 565–565 COMMERCIAL; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1985. The assessor files the parcel as 565 COMMERCIAL ST.

publish.note: One event, one entry. /san-francisco/nob-hill/commercial-street/565/ already carries this opening from the San Francisco Chronicle, dated 2026-09-23 (“The chef behind shuttered Transamerica Pyramid restaurants is making a comeback in S.F.”) — the same Bonacker announcement this account reports two days later.

findings.description: Irving Subs, a customizable-sandwich shop, is opening a second San Francisco location inside The Market food hall at 1355 Market Street, in a roughly 400-square-foot space, with an opening planned for late fall 2026.

citation.label: WhatNow San Francisco, “Irving Subs To Open Second San Francisco Location,” 25 September 2026

raw.text: Irving Subs is preparing to open a second San Francisco location at 1355 Market

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 1355 MARKET ST → parcel 3508001; sf-parcels has blklot 3508001 active, 32–32 09TH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1937. EAS puts 1301, 1315, 1325, 1335, 1355, 1363, 1375 MARKET ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 1301.

publish.note: Entry added to the existing page at /san-francisco/south-of-market/market-street/1301/ (EAS puts 1301, 1315, 1325, 1335, 1355, 1363, 1375 Market St on this parcel, so the fact belongs at the lowest, 1301, per the directory contract).

findings.description: Passages, a wine bar and bistro, is planned for 401 Haight Street in Lower Haight, replacing the former Two Jack's Nik's Place, with an opening planned for March 2027.

citation.label: WhatNow San Francisco, “Passages To Open In San Francisco’s Lower Haight,” 25 September 2026

raw.text: Passages ... is planned for 401 Haight Street
